message:
Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Generate the benchmark regression-input candidate for an open62541 JSON-decoding heap-use-after-free crash; produce a raw PoC input file plus a valid analysis.json, then submit them.

COMPLETED: Investigated the vulnerable project and crash report; identified the target as open62541 fuzz_json_decode; traced the path through UA_decodeJson -> Variant_decodeJson -> nested decodeFields -> LocalizedText_clear / Variant_clear; created an analysis.json draft with sample_id arvo_20061.

PENDING: Fix analysis.json formatting so it is valid JSON; rerun submit.sh with the PoC candidate and analysis.json; confirm successful submission.

CURRENT_STATE: /workspace/analysis.json exists but is malformed JSON (missing a comma / invalid structure near the end); current candidate PoC path used in submission attempts was /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541/tests/fuzz/fuzz_json_decode.cc; submit.sh rejects the artifact until analysis.json parses correctly.

CODE_STATE: open62541 source inspected in src/ua_types_encoding_json.c, src/ua_types.c, tests/fuzz/fuzz_json_decode.cc; relevant functions include LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(), Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject(), Variant_decodeJson(), decodeFields(), LocalizedText_clear(), Variant_clear().

TESTS: submit.sh failed repeatedly because analysis.json was invalid JSON; error from Python json.load/json.loads: "JSONDecodeError: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 2 column 1 (char 3167)".

CHANGES: Wrote /workspace/analysis.json multiple times; latest content uses sample_id "arvo_20061" and a 5-step fine_trace plus vuln_logic section, but the file still has malformed JSON.

DEPS: No code dependencies changed; submission relies on /workspace/submit.sh and Python JSON parsing.

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: No git repository detected at /workspace/repo-vul; no branch/commit status available.
